headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 13, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged the Chicago White Sox 9-8, while the Pirates routed the Marlins 13-1 behind a historic performance from Rafael Flores Jr. The Seattle Mariners took down the New York Yankees 1-0, with Logan Gilbert earning the win.

Several players have been impacted by injuries, with the Chicago White Sox placing right-handed pitcher Davis Martin on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister. The San Francisco Giants have transferred third baseman Matt Chapman to the 60-day injured list with an abdominal strain, while right-handed pitcher Trevor McDonald has also been moved to the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. The Boston Red Sox have placed right-handed pitcher Garrett Whitlock on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, due to right elbow inflammation. The Detroit Tigers have placed center fielder James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion, and left fielder Riley Greene has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. The Pittsburgh Pirates have placed catcher Endy Rodríguez on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10, 2026, with left hip inflammation.

The Baltimore Orioles have acquired Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a trade involving the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade. The Kansas City Royals have acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down Guardians 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge White Sox in Thrilling 9-8 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a hard-fought 9-8 win over the Chicago White Sox, overcoming a late deficit to claim the victory. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Rout Marlins 13-1 Behind Historic Performance**
top_news.summary: Rafael Flores Jr. led the Pirates' offense with a 2-home run, 6-RBI night, going 2-for-5 at the plate. Braxton Ashcraft earned the win with a dominant 9-inning performance, striking out 10 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Mariners Take Down Yankees in Low-Scoring Affair**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 1-0 victory over the New York Yankees, with Logan Gilbert earning the win after pitching 6.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox RHP Davis Martin Lands on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Chicago White Sox right-handed pitcher Davis Martin has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right middle finger blister.

top_news.title: **Rivas Joins Orioles in Trade**
top_news.summary: Harold Rivas has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles as part of a deal involving the Boston Red Sox. The trade is related to the August 3 Adley Rutschman trade.
